implementation_phases.description: Establish foundational infrastructure including environment validation and custom error types. These have no dependencies and enable all subsequent development.

tasks.title: Add environment variable validation at startup
tasks.rationale: Critical for fail-fast behavior on misconfiguration. No dependencies, highest priority.

tasks.title: Add comprehensive custom error types
tasks.rationale: Foundation for all error handling in subsequent tasks. Blocks 6 other tasks.

implementation_phases.completion_criteria: Environment validation operational and custom error types available for use

implementation_phases.description: Implement validation and retry mechanisms that depend on custom error types. These provide the reliability foundation for all API operations.

tasks.title: Add input validation for task creation
tasks.rationale: Prevents invalid data from reaching API. Required before batch creation.

tasks.title: Add input validation for task updates
tasks.rationale: Prevents invalid updates. Required before batch updates and archiving.

tasks.title: Add retry logic with exponential backoff
tasks.rationale: Critical reliability feature that blocks retrieval, rate limiting, and batch operations.

implementation_phases.completion_criteria: All validation and retry logic implemented and tested

implementation_phases.description: Implement task retrieval (completing CRUD operations) and database schema validation. These are critical features that unblock filtering and documentation.

tasks.title: Add task retrieval functionality
tasks.rationale: Completes CRUD operations (Create/Read/Update). Blocks all filtering features. Critical path.

tasks.title: Add database schema validation
tasks.rationale: Ensures database compatibility. Independent of retrieval, can run in parallel.

implementation_phases.completion_criteria: Task retrieval operational and schema validation available

implementation_phases.description: Implement all filtering capabilities, archiving, and rate limit handling. These enhance the core functionality with query and management features.

tasks.title: Add task filtering by status
tasks.rationale: Extends retrieval with status-based querying. Can run parallel with other filters.

tasks.title: Add task filtering by assignee
tasks.rationale: Extends retrieval with assignee-based querying. Can run parallel with other filters.

tasks.title: Add task filtering by date range
tasks.rationale: Extends retrieval with date-based querying. Lower priority, can run parallel with other filters.

tasks.title: Add task archiving functionality
tasks.rationale: Completes task lifecycle management. Requires validation and retry logic.

tasks.title: Add rate limit handling
tasks.rationale: Enhances reliability for high-volume usage. Builds on retry logic.

implementation_phases.completion_criteria: All filtering, archiving, and rate limit handling operational
implementation_phases.notes: All 5 tasks can execute simultaneously as dependencies are all from previous phases

implementation_phases.description: Implement batch creation and update operations for efficiency. These are lower priority enhancements for high-volume scenarios.

tasks.title: Add batch task creation operations
tasks.rationale: Enables efficient multi-task creation. Requires input validation and retry logic.

tasks.title: Add batch task update operations
tasks.rationale: Enables efficient multi-task updates. Requires update validation and retry logic.

implementation_phases.completion_criteria: Batch operations functional with proper error handling and partial failure support

implementation_phases.description: Complete comprehensive documentation after all major features are implemented. Ensures documentation accurately reflects all capabilities.

tasks.title: Enhance documentation with comprehensive usage guide
tasks.rationale: Must be last to document all features accurately. Requires retrieval, filtering, and archiving complete.

implementation_phases.completion_criteria: Complete, accurate documentation available with all features documented

critical_path.description: Error types → Retry logic → Retrieval → Filtering → Documentation

parallelization_opportunities: Phase 1: Both tasks can start immediately (2 parallel threads)
Phase 2: All 3 tasks can execute simultaneously (3 parallel threads)
Phase 3: Both tasks can execute simultaneously (2 parallel threads)
Phase 4: Up to 5 tasks can execute simultaneously depending on completion timing
Phase 5: Both tasks can execute simultaneously (2 parallel threads)
bottlenecks: TASK-002 blocks 6 other tasks - implement first
TASK-005 blocks 5 other tasks - high priority
TASK-006 blocks 4 other tasks - critical for filtering features
optimization_notes.priority_focus: Critical and high-priority tasks should be completed first: TASK-001, TASK-002, TASK-003, TASK-004, TASK-005, TASK-006, TASK-007
optimization_notes.optional_deferrable: Low-priority tasks TASK-010, TASK-013, TASK-014 can be deferred if resources are limited

implementation_guidelines.phase_transitions: Do not start next phase until all blocking dependencies from current and previous phases are complete
implementation_guidelines.parallel_execution: Within each phase, execute tasks concurrently when possible to minimize total implementation time
implementation_guidelines.testing_strategy: Test each task upon completion before marking as done. Integration testing after each phase.
implementation_guidelines.rollback_plan: Each task should be implemented in a way that allows independent rollback if issues arise
